# photo-decode test fixtures

Every file here is generated; none is a photograph or third-party image data.
`bash crates/photo-decode/scripts/make-fixtures.sh` rewrites them (macOS: it needs Apple's `sips`).

| File | Made by | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `quadrants-48.png` | `scripts/gen-quadrants.py` (Python stdlib, every pixel written by the script): 48x48, red/green/blue/white quadrants | AGPL-3.0-or-later, as this repository |
| `quadrants-48.jpg` | `sips -s format jpeg -s formatOptions 90` from the PNG | as above |
| `quadrants-48-lzw.tif` | `sips -s format tiff -s formatOptions lzw` from the PNG | as above |
| `quadrants-48.bmp` | `sips -s format bmp` from the PNG (the page's BMP sniff test) | as above |
| `quadrants-48-exif6.jpg` | `scripts/gen-turned.py` (stdlib): the JPEG above with an Exif segment saying Orientation 6 | as above |
| `turned-6.dng` | `scripts/gen-turned.py` (stdlib): a TIFF/DNG whose first directory says Orientation 6, its preview the JPEG above | as above |
| `checker-64.heic`, `checker-64.ref.png` | copied from heic-rs 0.1.5 `tests/fixtures` (generated by its `scripts/make-fixtures.sh`: a stdlib-written PNG encoded by `sips`; the `.ref.png` is Apple's decode of that HEIC) | MIT OR Apache-2.0 (heic-rs) |

The camera RAW shapes (DNG, CR2, NEF, ARW) are not files: `tests/common/mod.rs` builds each TIFF
container around `quadrants-48.jpg` byte by byte, so no camera's file is committed.
